about: Generated by conformance/family_oracle (make family-vectors). Do not edit by hand.
Every derived value comes from the independent Python oracle, never from Rust.
Rust tests read the inputs, recompute the outputs, and compare.
The cases are the registered vectors of quip/defects-static revision 1, generated by defects.py.
A case lists the salts that build in its instances and the salts that give code 14 in its skipped list.

The defect_witnesses section holds, for the first instance of each case, a feasible witness, an infeasible witness with low physical energy, and a witness that violates a pin. A witness holds one spin per instance node. An entry gives the expected feasible result, the observables, and the encoded energy in milli.

The routes section holds five original routes and twelve precedence cases on the first instance of defects-l3. An entry gives the paths as lattice vertex ids, the state as one spin per instance node, the first failed check or no error, and the feasible result of the state. A route never changes feasible.
The table section holds, for each case, the commitment of the dipolar table, the entry counts, the exact dropped magnitude, the truncation bound, and the penalty weight.
The admission section holds requests with their expected admission codes.
